Higher, further, faster (and of course also lower, less, slower), or just anything that is measurable – create multiple disciplines, input your accomplishments and view automatically created rankings.

izzyondroid:com.ki_bun.pioneer.name: Pioneer
izzyondroid:com.ki_bun.pioneer.description:
Pioneer is an open source tool to keep track of progress in an efficient way. Whether you are reading a book, .pdf, .epub, watching playlists, anime episodes, manga chapters, or anything else, Pioneer will act as one inventory to manage them, without relying on several different services for each.
 It is not just a tracker for watchlists, you can use it as a counter in general since it is optional to specify a maximum value, and also to keep track of a goal.

 Material 3 dynamic theme
 Local and offline progress tracking, no accounts or internet connection required
 Adding, deleting, and editing progress
 Privacy focused progress tracking app with no data collection, analytics, and telemetery
 Optional description and maximum value

izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.name: Android Virtual Pen
izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.summary: use your Android device to emulate a virtual pen on your PC
izzyondroid:com.virtual_pen.description:
Android Virtual Pen allows to send pen input data from your android device to a pc host where it emulates a virtual pen. What distinguishes this solution from others, is emphasis on low-latency to provide the best drawing experience.
 Features: 
 Adjustable pen pressure threshold such that you can move the pen-cursor without triggering an unintended click/draw action
 Adjustable pen pressure sensitivity such that you can customize the force needed to be applied
 Switch between stretched and fixed display mode In stretched mode, the android device screen is stretched and completely mapped to your PC primary screen. Note that this is required to fully reach the boundaries of your PC screen from your device but causes some slight distortion if the screen ratios (android vs PC) are not the same.
 In fixed mode, if the android device screen resolution fits into your PC screen, it is centered and mapped on that latter screen at a 1:1 ratio. This mode should incurr no distortion.
 Detect available usb devices and automatically save your settings for each
 Limitations: 
 Can only target one screen on the PC host (primary screen)
 Pen tilt is currently not supported (please do ask if you need this feature)
 No support on host side for MacOS and Windows

fdroid:com.aaronjwood.portauthority.name: Port Authority
fdroid:com.aaronjwood.portauthority.description:
A handy systems and security-focused tool, Port Authority is a very fast port
scanner. It also allows you to quickly discover hosts on your network and will
display useful network information about your device and other hosts.
One of the fastest port scanners with host discovery on the market! Host
discovery is typically performed in less than 5 seconds. If the device you're
scanning drops packets, it takes about 10 seconds to scan 1000 ports. If the
device you're scanning rejects packets, it takes less than 30 seconds to scan
all 65,535 ports!
 Features: 
* Heavily threaded, no more waiting for results one at a time
* LAN host discovery
* Public IP discovery
* MAC address vendor detection
* LAN/WAN host TCP port scanning
* Custom port range scans
* Open discovered HTTP(S) services to browser
* Lightweight service fingerprinting (SSH/HTTP(S) server type and version)
* DNS record lookups supporting almost every record type
* Wake-on-LAN for LAN hosts

fdroid:com.blackbox.app.name: BLACKBOX
fdroid:com.blackbox.app.description:
BLACKBOX is a clean, lightweight, offline-first security hub built for developers, creators, and anyone who values digital privacy. All data is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and stored on your device — nothing ever leaves without your explicit consent.
Core Modules:
- Secrets Manager: Store API keys, passwords, and tokens in categorized, encrypted vaults. Tap-to-reveal and one-tap copy.
- Encrypted Journal: Timestamped entries with category tags, all encrypted locally with your master PIN.
- 2FA / Authenticator: TOTP code generator with live countdown and manual secret entry. No cloud sync, no accounts needed.
- Privacy Tools: Permission audit, tracker URL cleaner, browser fingerprint viewer, and malicious URL scanner.
- Settings: Master PIN change, auto-lock timer, biometric unlock, panic mode with decoy calculator, screenshot blocking.
Security Features:
- AES-256-GCM encryption via Web Crypto API
- PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation with 150,000 iterations
- FLAG_SECURE screenshot and screen recording blocking
- Biometric unlock (fingerprint / face) via Android BiometricPrompt
- Panic mode: calculator decoy triggered by PIN prefix
- Auto-lock on inactivity or app switch
- 100% offline — no network calls, no analytics, no tracking
BLACKBOX is free, open-source, and built with Capacitor for Android. No proprietary dependencies. No cloud. No compromises.

Use the special "lockdown mode" to turn an Android tablet into a dedicated, single-purpose audiobook and podcast device.
Designed for:
- Elderly who want simple, independent listening
- Visually impaired users who benefit from large controls and spoken titles
- Non-tech-savvy users who find standard apps overwhelming
- People with cognitive challenges who need basic functionality
Easy to use:
- Large, easy-to-tap buttons
- Simple navigation with swipe left/right
- Flat content structure (no deep nested folders)
- No ads, no pop-ups, no distracting clutter
- Optional title read-aloud for accessibility

Lockdown mode:
- only playback functionality
- blocks exiting the app
- hides settings
- no access to other apps, notifications nor settings

- Play DRM-free audiobooks from device storage
- Resume position saved separately for each book
Podcasts:

apple-macos:6777684340.description:
Cloudbreak is a fast, private weather app for people who actually watch the sky — built with a fire-weather edge for anyone living in or near wildfire country.
Open it and you get a clean, honest read on right now: current conditions, an hourly strip you can scan at a glance, and a seven-day outlook — sourced from the U.S. National Weather Service and, in Canada, Environment and Climate Change Canada. Tap any detail for a 24-hour chart of humidity, wind, pressure, UV, visibility, and more, or drag the sun along its arc to see exactly how much daylight is left.
Where Cloudbreak goes further is fire and air:
• Fire-weather risk — the day's expected max, from Low to Extreme, with the official drivers (humidity, wind, Haines index) and a 48-hour outlook, so an elevated day never catches you off guard. Official NWS data in the U.S.; a clearly-labeled modeled estimate anywhere else. Each day in the 7-day forecast is flagged for its peak fire risk, too.
• A dedicated fire map — active incidents and perimeters, satellite hotspots, smoke, and historical burn scars (official USGS/USFS records for major fires), each a layer you can turn on or off, with a tap-through detail on every feature.
• Smoke and air quality — live AQI with a multi-day outlook, plus NOAA smoke plumes on the map, so you know when to keep the windows shut.
• National Weather Service and Environment Canada alerts — the most severe warning for your area, front and center.
Explore the weather visually: play NEXRAD radar forward past now with a short-range forecast, loop GOES GeoColor satellite imagery, read surface wind and temperature fields, and add lightning or air-quality overlays on top — with active-fire hotspots available over any of them.
Have your own hardware? Connect a personal weather station — Ambient Weather, Tempest, Davis, Netatmo, or PWSWeather — and Cloudbreak blends your backyard readings into the forecast. (Newer providers are marked Beta in the app.)
Cloudbreak comes with an Apple Watch app, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and a native Mac app, so the forecast is wherever you are.
Private by design
We don't run servers that store your data, and there are no accounts to create. Your location is sent to public weather and fire-data providers only to fetch a forecast — it is never stored by us, never tied to your name, and never used to build a profile. No ads. No analytics. No third-party tracking. The keys for any station you connect are kept in the Keychain and reach your other devices only through iCloud Keychain.
Full guide, FAQ, and support: apps.stonemesastudio.com
Fire-weather, smoke, and air-quality information is for general awareness — always follow official guidance from local authorities in an emergency.

Bring the records on your phone, NAS and cloud drives into one library. Listen to an album without gaps at home, pick up your audiobook in CarPlay, or turn down the vocals on a favorite track and sing along.
Your files, servers and cloud drives

Connect compatible music servers, Synology, QNAP or ZSpace storage, and cloud drives including Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and 115. Browse shared folders over SMB, WebDAV, FTP/SFTP, NFS, S3 or UPnP/DLNA. Stream on demand or download music with its artwork and lyrics for offline listening. Choose which sources to use on each device.
Sound and formats
Play FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, APE, WavPack, DSD, DTS, MP3, AAC and more. Browse single-file albums by track with CUE sheets, open SACD or DVD-Audio images, and read track names and ReplayGain from matching SACD Metabase XML files. Use gapless playback for a live album or crossfade a playlist. Calibrate headphones or speakers with an AutoEQ curve measured for your model. Reconnecting the device recalls its profile. Adjust EQ and reverb, or use DoP with a compatible DAC.
Lyrics, artwork and karaoke
Follow line- or word-synced lyrics, translations and duet parts. Choose which embedded lyrics to use, find lyrics online, or set the timing yourself as a song plays. Save the result inside a supported file or alongside it. Give albums video covers and switch between vinyl, cover walls and music-reactive visuals.
On supported tracks, turn down the original vocals, switch to the instrumental, change key, loop a difficult line, score your singing or record it. Sing Along is unavailable for tracks played by the system music player. Optional on-device AI vocal separation requires iOS/iPadOS 26.4 or later and a model download. Medleys let you sample tracks and return to a full song.
Rediscover your collection
Browse by artist, album, genre or folder, or search for a line you remember from a song. Group same-title albums across sources. Build a smart playlist for rock tracks you haven’t played in a month and let it change as you listen.
Edit titles in batches, correct artist names or covers, and save changes to supported sources. Choose which duplicate to keep while preserving files on read-only sources. Revisit your most-played albums in your listening charts and year in review.

Connect your own audiobook server or play your M4B files. Keep chapters, bookmarks, narration speed, a sleep timer and your place in each book. Browse podcast shows, save favorite episodes and follow searchable transcripts when available. Add stations by stream URL or subscribe to M3U or PLS lists. Organize stations in folders and see the current track when the broadcaster provides it.
On iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay
Give the player its own bass-reactive background or fill the Lock Screen with artwork. Choose music and adjust audiobook speed in CarPlay. See lyrics, change tracks and browse the queue on your watch. Use Siri, Spotlight, widgets, Control Center and AirPlay, or share lyrics as an image, video or Live Photo.
Sync and discovery
Sync supported playlists, sources and preferences with iCloud. Send music, lyrics and artwork over your local network. Restore your recent music queue with its order and position, see your most-played tracks and choose how long a song must play to count as a listen. Optional AI tools offer semantic search, translation and transcription. Online transcription sends audio only with your consent.

firefox-addons:3028095.summary: Create custom themes in seconds. Use live preview, smart color pickers, and a randomizer to design your perfect browser look.
firefox-addons:3028095.description:
Take full control over your browser's look with Theme Customizer - for Firefox!
Whether you prefer a sleek dark mode, a vibrant colorful setup, or a clean minimalist design, this extension lets you mix and match colors for your browser interface in just a few clicks. No design skills or coding required—just pick your colors and enjoy a personalized browsing experience.
Key Features:
• ✨ Full Interface Customization: Instantly change the colors of your browser frame (top bar), toolbars, tabs, and active window areas.
• 🎨 Smart Color Pickers: Use intuitive color wheels to find your favorite shades or enter exact RGB values for maximum precision.
• ⚡ Quick Contrast Buttons: Swap text colors between pure white and solid black instantly to ensure perfect readability.
• ↩️ Design History (Undo): Made a mistake? Quickly reload your previous design with the "Load Last Design" feature.
• 🗑️ Safe One-Click Reset: Want a fresh start? Instantly restore the original Firefox default theme anytime.
• 💾 Persistent Storage: Your custom creations are saved automatically and reload instantly whenever you restart Firefox.
How to use:
1. Click the Theme Customizer icon in your toolbar.
2. Select your desired colors for the Frame, Toolbar, and Text.
3. Click Apply Design to see the changes instantly.
Note: This extension respects your privacy. All your themes and preferences are stored locally on your device and are never shared or sent to any servers.
